title: Always Learning, Always Mixing: Efficient and Simple Data Mixing All the Time
abstract: arXiv:2605.15220v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Data mixing decides how to combine different sources or types of data and is a consequential problem throughout language model training. In pretraining, data composition is a key determinant of model quality; in continual learning and adaptation, it governs what is retained and acquired. Yet existing data mixing methods address only one phase of this lifecycle at a time: some require smaller proxy models tied to a single training phase, others assume a fixed domain set, and continual learning lacks principled guidance altogether. We argue that data mixing is fundamentally an online decision making problem---one that recurs throughout training and demands a single, unified solution. We introduce OP-Mix (On-Policy Mix), a data mixing algorithm that operates across pretraining, midtraining, and instruction tuning. Our main insight is that candidate data mixtures can be cheaply simulated by interpolating between low-rank adapters t

translated_title: 持续学习，持续混合：贯穿训练全程的高效简洁数据混合方法
translated_abstract: 数据混合决定了如何组合不同的数据来源或数据类型，是语言模型训练全过程中的一个重要问题。在预训练阶段，数据构成是决定模型质量的关键因素；在持续学习与适应阶段，它决定了模型保留什么、习得什么。然而，现有的数据混合方法每次只能处理这一生命周期中的单一阶段：有些方法需要与单一训练阶段绑定的小型代理模型，有些方法假设领域集合固定不变，而持续学习则完全缺乏原则性的指导。我们认为，数据混合从根本上是一个在线决策问题——它在整个训练过程中反复出现，需要一个统一的解决方案。我们提出了OP-Mix（On-Policy Mix，在线策略混合），这是一种可跨预训练、中期训练和指令微调运行的数据混合算法。我们的核心洞察是：候选数据混合方案可以通过在低秩适配器之间进行插值来低成本地模拟……（原文此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出OP-Mix算法，将数据混合视为贯穿预训练、中期训练和指令微调全生命周期的在线决策问题，通过在低秩适配器之间插值来低成本模拟候选混合方案，从而用一个统一简洁的方法解决训练各阶段的数据混合需求。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes OP-Mix, which frames data mixing as an online decision-making problem spanning pretraining, midtraining, and instruction tuning, using cheap interpolation between low-rank adapters to simulate candidate mixtures for a unified and efficient mixing solution.
